js: (function(){var d=window.__dbg,T=d.THREE;d.bed.updateMatrixWorld(true);var bb=new T.Box3().setFromObject(d.bed);var size=bb.getSize(new T.Vector3());var c=bb.getCenter(new T.Vector3());var th=d.terrainHeight(c.x,c.z);var cg=[[bb.min.x,bb.min.z],[bb.max.x,bb.min.z],[bb.min.x,bb.max.z],[bb.max.x,bb.max.z],[c.x,c.z]].map(function(p){return +d.terrainHeight(p[0],p[1]).toFixed(3);});function cnt(mesh){if(!mesh||!mesh.count)return null;var m=new T.Matrix4(),v=new T.Vector3(),n=0;for(var i=0;i<mesh.count;i++){mesh.getMatrixAt(i,m);v.setFromMatrixPosition(m).applyMatrix4(mesh.matrixWorld);if(v.x>=bb.min.x&&v.x<=bb.max.x&&v.z>=bb.min.z&&v.z<=bb.max.z)n++;}return n;}var r=(window.__rig&&window.__rig.rig)||d.__rig.rig;return JSON.stringify({cfgBedScale:d.config.bed.scale,cfgSizesBedScale:d.config.sizes&&d.config.sizes.bedScale,groupScale:[+d.bed.scale.x.toFixed(4),+d.bed.scale.y.toFixed(4),+d.bed.scale.z.toFixed(4)],boxSize:[+size.x.toFixed(3),+size.y.toFixed(3),+size.z.toFixed(3)],boxMin:[+bb.min.x.toFixed(3),+bb.min.y.toFixed(3),+bb.min.z.toFixed(3)],bedTop:+r.bed.top.toFixed(3),rigRx:+r.bed.rx.toFixed(3),rigRz:+r.bed.rz.toFixed(3),avoidHalf:d.config.bed.avoidHalf,daisyCenters:d.config.bed.daisyCenters,bedY:+d.bed.position.y.toFixed(3),groundUnder:+th.toFixed(3),cornerGround:cg,cornerSpread:+(Math.max.apply(null,cg)-Math.min.apply(null,cg)).toFixed(3),grassIn:cnt(d.grass),tuftIn:cnt(d.tufts),lavIn:cnt(d.lavender),daisyIn:cnt(d.daisies),errs:(window.__errs||[]).slice(0,5)});})()
